about: Build log of the place uk-lite (United Kingdom (lite buildings), kind lite) by cwplans/tools/build-place-tiles.mjs (danbri/londat): what was fetched (URL, date, SHA-256) and each dataflow activity with its input and output hashes. OPTIONAL { ?w osmkey:wikidata ?wd } OPTIONAL { ?w osmkey:wikipedia ?wp } OPTIONAL { ?w osmkey:historic ?hist } OPTIONAL { ?w osmkey:man_made ?mm } OPTIONAL { ?w osmkey:leisure ?leis } OPTIONAL { ?w osmkey:name ?name } FILTER(BOUND(?wd) || BOUND(?wp) || ?b IN ("cathedral", "castle", "palace", "stadium", "grandstand", "tower", "lighthouse", "windmill") || ?hist IN ("castle", "palace", "fort", "tower", "monastery", "abbey", "city_gate") || ?mm IN ("tower", "lighthouse", "windmill", "water_tower") || ?leis IN ("stadium")) }

osm-part-shapes.request: SPARQL POST (text/tab-separated-values): PREFIX osmkey: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:> PREFIX osmrel: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/> PREFIX ogc: <http://www.opengis.net/rdf#> SELECT ?p ?rs ?bp WHERE { osmrel:62149 ogc:sfContains ?p . ?p osmkey:building:part ?bp . OPTIONAL { ?p osmkey:roof:shape ?rs } FILTER(?bp IN ("spire", "steeple", "tower", "church_tower", "bell_tower", "clock_tower", "minaret", "belfry") || ?rs IN ("pyramidal", "cone", "conical", "spire", "dome", "onion")) }
osm-part-shapes.use: roof:shape and building:part of building parts, joined to the Overture parts by OSM id

osm-structures.request: SPARQL POST (text/tab-separated-values): PREFIX osmkey: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:> PREFIX osmrel: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/> PREFIX ogc: <http://www.opengis.net/rdf#> PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> SELECT ?e ?mm ?hist ?tour ?name ?h ?wd ?wp ?wkt WHERE { osmrel:62149 ogc:sfContains ?e . OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:man_made ?mm } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:historic ?hist } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:tourism ?tour } FILTER(?mm IN ("tower", "chimney", "obelisk", "lighthouse", "mast", "monument") || ?hist IN ("monument", "memorial", "castle") || ?tour IN ("artwork")) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?e osmkey:building ?b } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:name ?name } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:height ?h } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:wikidata ?wd } OPTIONAL { ?e osmkey:wikipedia ?wp } FILTER(BOUND(?wd) || BOUND(?wp) || (BOUND(?name) && BOUND(?h))) ?e geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wkt . }
osm-structures.use: structures that are not OSM buildings (landmark rule of place.lite.structures): kind, name, height, wikidata, wikipedia, geometry (WKT)
